description: The plot in Figure 8 illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of a model, comparing various configurations. The x-axis is labeled with layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) and has a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale, ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick labels at intervals of 5%. The plot contains five lines: a blue dashed line representing the baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit, a blue solid line with circle markers for LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit, a blue dashed line with circle markers for LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit, a red solid line with square markers for RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit, and a red dashed line with square markers for RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit. The blue solid line starts at around 0% and decreases to approximately -3% at Layer21-28 before increasing to around 0% at Layer29-32. The blue dashed line with circle markers begins at around 0%, drops to about -4% at Layer21-28, and then rises to roughly 0% at Layer29-32. The red solid line with square markers starts at approximately 0%, declines sharply to around -20% at Layer21-28, and then increases to about -5% at Layer29-32. The red dashed line with square markers begins at around 0%, decreases to approximately -22% at Layer21-28, and then rises to about -5% at Layer29-32.
